title.rendered: Coffee / Tea Fundraiser with Barnes & Noble

content.rendered: Help support Laurel Ridge and enjoy a great cup of coffee or tea at the same time!  We are partnering with Barnes & Noble to provide fresh-roasted, fair-trade coffee and tea.  See HERE for more information and the coffee order form.  See HERE for the tea order form.
